field_semantics.party[].species: IDENTITY — the only battle-facing field; the build input (PM ruling D4, 2026-11-23)
field_semantics.party[].level: IDENTITY-HISTORY ONLY — the source game's recorded level for that tier; provenance, NEVER a build value
field_semantics.party[].iv: IDENTITY-HISTORY ONLY — the source game's recorded IV value (iv_scale, 0-255 scale); provenance, NEVER a build value
field_semantics.build_rule: Tier tables supply species/identity only. Every rematch battle party is built at battle time by the difficulty layer (PUWTeamBuilder.build_trainer_team / build_mon): exactly 6 Pokemon, IV 31 in every stat, EV spread = the species' best sourced set under the 510 cap, best nature/ability/moveset (egg moves included where the sourced set carries them), level scaled to the player, sets re-sourced on evolution with EV redistribution only where the evolved build requires it. Applies identically to Pokemon and Moemon parties — Moemon mirror PKDX stats/moves/evolutions, so the same builder and the same sourced sets produce Moemon parties at the identical standard; no separate, weaker path.

prize_money.formula: prize_base = 4 * (level of last party member) * class_prize_multiplier * (2 if double_battle else 1)
prize_money.source: include/data/trainer_class_prize_mul.h (sTrainerClassPrizeMul) + src/battle/battle_script.c (BattleScript_CalcPrizeMoney: prize = lastLevel * 4 * prizeMoneyMul * class mul, doubled only for BATTLE_TYPE_DOUBLES; prizeMoneyMul is the Amulet Coin seam the prep applies on top, so it is NOT folded into prize_base). Classes absent from sTrainerClassPrizeMul default to 0 in the source array.

provenance: Transcribed from held pokeplatinum source (read under Riley's standing mechanics authorization; data extraction only, no downloaded code built or run). Tier rows: src/overlay005/vs_seeker.c gVsSeekerRematchData[] ('_' / VS_SEEKER_REMATCH_DATA_NONE preserved as null; VS_SEEKER_REMATCH_DATA_END terminates the row, as in the source, and is not a tier; NoUniqueRematches(X) expands to {X, X, END...} exactly as the source macro defines). Parties: res/trainers/data/<trainer>.json (one file per trainer id). prize_base derived per tier with the source formula in prize_money (include/data/trainer_class_prize_mul.h sTrainerClassPrizeMul + src/battle/battle_script.c BattleScript_CalcPrizeMoney). iv is the source iv_scale value verbatim (0-255 scale; per-stat IV = iv_scale*31/255 per src/trainer_data.c with MAX_IV_SCALE 255). Party fields with no fixture counterpart (moves when non-null, held_item when item is non-null, form when non-zero, ball_seal when non-zero) are carried on the party entries, never dropped; null moves means the source uses default level-up moves, null item means no held item.
